items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: single wide landscape 16:9 resource illustration for MarcBook "QuimiLab".
Primary request: an inviting hand-drawn scene specifically about practicing inorganic chemical formulation, nomenclature and classification with formula flashcards. The real artifact is a self-paced gamified nomenclature trainer, with oxide/salt classification, levels and environmental context in Andorra. It is NOT a wet laboratory simulation.
Subject and scene: central foreground wooden desk with large neat formula cards bearing only "CaO", "NaCl", "CO₂", each clearly distinguishable and sorted into three small purple-edged card boxes. An open science notebook shows one large accurate "CO₂" formula next to a minimal linear red-black-red model sketch. A neat modest periodic table grid and a small staircase of three progress check marks sit behind the cards. Through the back window a soft painted mountain valley and river evoke the environmental application without dominating the formula practice.
Style: elegant fine ink drawing, watercolor fills, subtle paper texture, 2D hand-painted animated-film background style for professional secondary-school education. Warm ivory light, pale lavender shadows, purple boxes and orange notebook/pencil. Same warm detailed illustration language as MarcBook's illustrated classroom scenes.
Composition: wide horizontal, a few large formula cards and notebook are the unmistakable focus, safe central 80% for thumbnail crop. No people necessary.
Text constraints: only three card formulas "CaO", "NaCl", "CO₂" and the notebook "CO₂", clearly and accurately lettered. No invented prose, logos or title. No liquid-filled beakers, no cartoon professor, no photorealism, no 3D render, no fake app interface, no extra atoms around the card.
items.qa: Verified CaO, NaCl and CO2 flashcards, nomenclature context, linear CO2 sketch; no liquid lab simulation.

items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: single wide landscape 16:9 resource cover for MarcBook "La balança química".
Primary request: a clear refined drawn science scene about balancing equations and conservation of atoms, illustrated as a level brass balance with correctly composed molecules on its two pans.
Subject: center a level two-pan balance on a wooden classroom desk, two equal-height pans. Left pan shows exactly two H₂ molecules (two paired white spheres each) and one O₂ molecule (one paired red-sphere pair). Right pan shows exactly two H₂O molecules, each one red oxygen attached to two white hydrogens in a bent V. Both sides must contain four white hydrogen atoms and two red oxygen atoms. Label a paper strip across the top of the scene exactly "2 H₂ + O₂ → 2 H₂O". Make all atoms large and individually countable. Soft lavender background wash and orange/purple notebooks low in the corners.
Style: fine ink outlines, warm watercolor on subtly textured paper, 2D hand-painted animated-film drawing, professional educational publishing. Ivory ground with deep-purple and orange accents. Objects clearly drawn, not photographic or CGI.
Composition: horizontal 16:9 with balance and both pans safely inside the middle 80%; no crowding, no extra disconnected atoms, no people, no unrelated plants/food. The balanced pans and countable atom conservation should read at thumbnail size.
Constraints: correct equation and EXACT specified atom counts. The balance is an educational visual analogy; no changing elements, no invented equations, no extra text or watermarks, no photorealism, no UI screenshot.
items.qa: Verified 4 H and 2 O atoms on each side, two H2 and one O2 on left, two bent H2O on right, balanced equation.

items.initialPrompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: individual landscape cover illustration for MarcBook's "Construcció de molècules", ideally 16:9.
Primary request: a professional hand-drawn educational illustration of physically assembling molecular ball-and-stick models with a real classroom model kit. This resource actually asks learners to build models, check valence and compare correct/incorrect constructions.
Scene: a warmly lit wooden classroom science table. Central foreground an accurate water molecule, one red oxygen sphere connected with two sticks to two white hydrogen spheres in a bent V, and an accurate linear carbon dioxide molecule, red oxygen—double grey bonds—black carbon—double grey bonds—red oxygen. Nearby a blue nitrogen sphere and three white hydrogens arranged as a small accurate ammonia model; separate spare model-kit colored spheres and grey flexible connectors in a shallow tray, open unlabelled sketch notebook with molecular sketches and a small simple periodic-table grid in background. Make assembly and tangible kit pieces the obvious subject.
Style/medium: refined fine ink outlines, warm watercolor fills and subtle paper texture, 2D hand-painted Japanese animated-film background feeling, professional secondary school science, same warmth as the approved MarcBook illustrations. Soft ivory ground, pale lavender wash, purple notebook edge and orange tray accent. Neither photorealistic nor plastic CGI.
Composition: wide horizontal image, three distinct assembled models clearly spaced; all essential atoms and bonds inside middle 80 percent of canvas, table props secondary. Legible at a small thumbnail. No people required.
Constraints: scientifically correct atom colors and bond counts. Molecules are tangible drawn kit models, not real liquids. No labels, no prose, no title, no formulas, no logos or watermark; no beakers, no unrelated food, no generic apple/atom icon.
